signingCustody.productionKeys: user-owned under chain/security/key-custody-v0.json; never generated, stored, or used by automation in this repository
signingCustody.rehearsalKeys: throwaway Ed25519 keys generated per rehearsal run inside the untracked output directory, clearly valueless, never committed

reproducibility.builder: digest-pinned golang container from chain/toolchain.json, CGO musl, -trimpath, -buildvcs=false, fixed ldflags, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the release commit
reproducibility.container: BuildKit OCI archive with rewrite-timestamp and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; base images digest-pinned in chain/app/Dockerfile
reproducibility.proof: two independent --no-cache builds must produce byte-identical SHA256SUMS across binaries, archives, and the OCI image (chain/releases/build-release-v0.sh --reproducibility-check); verified 2026-07-29
reproducibility.knownNonHermeticInput: apk package installs resolve against the Alpine repository at build time; the double build fails closed if the repository state drifts between the two builds. apk's own /var/log/apk.log records wall-clock install time and is removed inside the same Dockerfile layer, and BuildKit's provenance/SBOM attestations are disabled because this pipeline issues its own.

sbom.source: chain/app/go.mod + chain/app/go.sum plus digest-pinned toolchain images; deterministic ordering, no network access

provenance.format: in-toto Statement v1 with SLSA provenance v1 predicate
provenance.subjects: every built binary, archive, and OCI image digest from SHA256SUMS

gatedInputsRule.statement: A release build may only consume artifacts that passed the #121 gates; the builder refuses to run on a dirty tree and records the exact commit it built.
gatedInputsRule.heavyGate: chain-acceptance runs label-gated or locally per the chain E2E policy; a public release additionally requires its local five-suite evidence

workflow.trigger: workflow_dispatch only; never on push or pull_request
workflow.behavior: runs the same build + verify scripts and uploads the output as a workflow artifact; it publishes nothing and has no registry, image, or release permissions

verification: chain/releases/verify-release-v0.mjs checks SHA256SUMS, SBOM/go.sum agreement, provenance materials against the pinned toolchain, and Ed25519 signatures when a public key is supplied
holds: No publication: no registry push, no GitHub release, no image push, no public download endpoint until the user-owned release phase approves one.
Production signing keys and their custody remain user-owned (#117/#121); rehearsals use throwaway keys only.
Version numbers stay 0.1.0-local.* until a public release decision assigns a real scheme.
